mapper.select: SELECT dt.trade_id AS tradeId, dt.general_customer_id AS generalCustomerId, dt.trade_type AS tradeType, dt.stock_code AS stockCode, dt.qty AS qty, dt.price AS price, dt.executed_at AS executedAt FROM domestic_trade dt JOIN general_customer gc ON gc.general_customer_id = dt.general_customer_id WHERE gc.ci_hash = #{ciHash} ORDER BY dt.executed_at DESC
